name: Weatherbit
tagline: Global weather, air quality, and energy/agri APIs with a free developer tier.
description: Weatherbit provides global current weather, forecasts, historical data, air quality, and agriculture/energy endpoints via a REST API. Developers authenticate with an API key and can start on a free tier with documented daily request limits.

auth.details: API key via query parameter key=YOUR_API_KEY (or header in some SDKs); self-serve signup.

use_cases: get current weather for a city
get multi-day weather forecast by coordinates
retrieve historical weather for a date range
check air quality index for a location
